additional_info.subject: RE: 0367095 - ID0367095-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002830] Charger was unavailable in OCPP CRM:02023000042
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Oliver Zimmermann,﻿
You received 30 status notifications indicating that a charger was unavailable because it was offline on the server. This happened because the charger did not receive "pong" from the server, causing the connection to be closed. Once the charger came back online, it sent all the pending messages that were queued during the offline period.
If you have any further questions or need additional information, please let me know!
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
